raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#44220 (merged) makes a Full prefill CUDA graph replay wait for an in-flight HiCache / external-linker layer-wise load, and leaves breakable replays alone because their eager breaks still run the per-layer waits in the pool accessors.

That holds only while every read of loaded state happens at an eager break. Since #41105, a breakable graph captures the Triton KDA extend inside a graph segment instead of breaking at each KDA layer. Its KDA state reads then run inside the replayed segment, where no per-layer wait runs, so a loading batch can read KDA state before that layer's load lands and produce wrong logits silently.

This is reachable with default flags: GLM-5.3-Flash enables breakable prefill graphs by default (#42845), and on Hopper the KDA extend defaults to the Triton kernel (`flashinfer_kda_prefill_default` picks FlashInfer only on SM100/SM103). With HiCache on, a host-tier hit then replays the captured KDA extend over an unfinished load. On Blackwell the default FlashInfer KDA prefill is not captured, but `--enable-deterministic-inference` or `--linear-attn-prefill-backend triton` brings the Triton path back.

## Modifications

- `AttentionBackend.breakable_graph_reads_captured_state` (default False): set when a breakable prefill graph reads layer state inside a captured segment. `HybridLinearAttnBackend` sets it exactly when it captures the linear extend, the same decision that enables the capture.
- `PrefillCudaGraphRunner`: a replay waits for the whole in-flight load first when the backend is Full, or breakable with captured state reads (`_replay_waits_for_whole_load`, resolved once at init). Every other breakable replay keeps per-layer load/compute overlap, so e.g. Inkling and DeepSeek-V4 under breakable graphs are unchanged.
- The existing `use_captured_forward_metadata_for_breakable_cuda_graph` is not reused: DeepSeek-V4 sets it for captured attention metadata while its KV reads still run at eager breaks, so keying on it would drop their overlap for no reason.

## Accuracy Tests

GLM-5.3-Flash (FP8), 4x GB300, TP4, `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable --linear-attn-prefill-backend triton` (log confirms "Breakable prefill CUDA graphs capture the KDAAttnBackend extend"), HiCache L1+L2 with a tight device pool (`--max-total-tokens 8192 --max-mamba-cache-size 32`) so turns hit the host tier, `SGLANG_TEST_HICACHE_H2D_DELAY_CYCLES=50000000`. Multi-turn branching workload (9 samples), KL against a cold replay; 24 replays with an in-flight load per run. GLM has no bit-exact oracle and rare single-sample outliers, so medians are compared.

| Tree | H2D delay | KDA capture | median KL |
|---|---|---|---|
| #44220 head | no | on | 1.9e-4 (floor) |
| #44220 head (2 runs) | yes | on | 3.5e-3 / 4.1e-3 |
| #44220 head | yes | off (`SGLANG_DISABLE_KDA_PREFILL_GRAPH_EXTEND=1`) | 1.2e-4 |
| every breakable replay waits for the whole load (the wait this PR applies in this configuration) | yes | on | 1.4e-4 |

The last row measures the same wait through a variant that applies it to every breakable replay. This exact commit, rebased onto main (which now includes #44220), was then measured on 8x B300 (4 GPUs, TP4). GLM-5.3-Flash used bf16 weights, FP8 KV and TRT-LLM DSA, with the same breakable + Triton KDA flags, pools and delay. The same 9-sample harness ran 3 times per arm, each run with 22 prefill-graph replays and 6168 loaded tokens. Samples 1-8 move between the same few values in every arm, including the no-delay floor. Only sample 9 separates the arms:

| Tree | H2D delay | sample-9 KL (3 runs) |
|---|---|---|
| main | no | 4.1e-4 / 1.1e-3 / 3.7e-3 (floor) |
| main | yes | 4.5e-2 / 4.5e-2 / 1.5e-2 |
| this PR | yes | 8.3e-4 / 4.1e-4 / 9.6e-4 |

The wiring is checked below.

Default-flag check on 1x H200 (an 8-layer GLM-5.3-Flash with dummy weights, no graph or KDA flags): the log shows `extend=TritonKDAKernel` and "Breakable prefill CUDA graphs capture the KDAAttnBackend extend", with breakable replays carrying an in-flight HiCache load. Dummy weights are too flat to show the KL effect, so the KL table above uses real weights with the Triton path forced. On this PR's tree the same server logs `waits_for_whole_load=True` for `HybridLinearAttnBackend`, so those replays now wait.

## Tests

- `test_prefill_cuda_graph_runner.py::TestPrefillCudaGraphRunnerLayerLoads::test_breakable_replay_waits_when_it_captures_state_reads`: Full waits, breakable without captured state reads does not, breakable with captured state reads does. Negative control: ignoring the flag fails it (`False != True`).
- `test_prefill_cuda_graph_runner.py`: 19 passed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Code Formatting with Pre-Commit.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [x] Provide accuracy evaluation results.

@@ -161,6 +161,9 @@ def draft_extend_metadata_captured_in_graph(self) -> bool:
     # those tensor addresses. Such backends opt in here, create the metadata
     # object during capture, and refresh its dynamic fields before each replay.
     use_captured_forward_metadata_for_breakable_cuda_graph: bool = False
+    # A breakable prefill graph reads layer state inside a captured segment, where
+    # the pool accessors' per-layer load waits never run.
+    breakable_graph_reads_captured_state: bool = False
     # Most requests one replay of that captured metadata can carry (None: no
     # bound). Fixed at init: the dp-attention replay vote checks it too.
     prefill_cuda_graph_max_batch_size: Optional[int] = None

@@ -256,6 +256,17 @@ class _ChunkedPrefixCaptureBuffers:
     kv_indices: torch.Tensor  # (max_chunks, prefix_chunk_capacity)
 
 
+def _replay_waits_for_whole_load(backend: Any, attn_backend: Any) -> bool:
+    # Full replay skips the per-layer load waits in the pool accessors; breakable
+    # replay runs them at its eager breaks unless a captured segment reads state.
+    if isinstance(backend, FullCudaGraphBackend):
+        return True
+    return (
+        isinstance(backend, BreakableCudaGraphBackend)
+        and attn_backend.breakable_graph_reads_captured_state
+    )
+
+
 def prefill_failure_msg(backend_name: str) -> str:
     """Render PREFILL_CUDA_GRAPH_CAPTURE_FAILED_MSG with a backend-specific
     numbered suggestion list. The runner is only constructed for BREAKABLE
@@ -660,6 +671,9 @@ def __init__(self, model_runner: ModelRunner):
         self.attn_metadata_buffers: Optional[Dict[ShapeKey, object]] = (
             {} if self.use_captured_attn_metadata else None
         )
+        self._waits_for_whole_load = _replay_waits_for_whole_load(
+            self.backend, model_runner.attn_backend
+        )
 
         # BCG and Full CG capture only the transformer body (layer_model.forward),
         # not the LM head + logits_processor — the eager tail keeps the captured
@@ -2285,9 +2299,7 @@ def _validate_capture_hidden_mode(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> None:
             )
 
     def _wait_for_layer_loads(self) -> None:
-        # Full replay skips the per-layer load waits in the pool accessors; breakable
-        # replay still runs them at its eager breaks.
-        if not self._is_full_backend:
+        if not self._waits_for_whole_load:
             return
         counter = self.model_runner.token_to_kv_pool.layer_transfer_counter
         if counter is not None and counter.consumer_index >= 0:

@@ -758,9 +758,9 @@ def test_prefix_gate_only_applies_to_chunked_prefix_variant(self):
 
 class TestPrefillCudaGraphRunnerLayerLoads(CustomTestCase):
     @staticmethod
-    def _runner(counter, is_full_backend=True):
+    def _runner(counter, waits_for_whole_load=True):
         runner = PrefillCudaGraphRunner.__new__(PrefillCudaGraphRunner)
-        runner._is_full_backend = is_full_backend
+        runner._waits_for_whole_load = waits_for_whole_load
         runner.model_runner = SimpleNamespace(
             token_to_kv_pool=SimpleNamespace(layer_transfer_counter=counter)
         )
@@ -792,13 +792,38 @@ def test_breakable_replay_keeps_per_layer_load_overlap(self):
         counter = LayerWiseLoadCounter(num_layers=3)
         counter.set_consumer(counter.update_producer())
         waiter = threading.Thread(
-            target=self._runner(counter, is_full_backend=False)._wait_for_layer_loads,
+            target=self._runner(
+                counter, waits_for_whole_load=False
+            )._wait_for_layer_loads,
             daemon=True,
         )
         waiter.start()
         waiter.join(timeout=5)
         self.assertFalse(waiter.is_alive())
 
+    def test_breakable_replay_waits_when_it_captures_state_reads(self):
+        """A breakable graph that reads layer state inside a captured segment never
+        runs that layer's load wait, so it must wait for the whole load like Full."""
+        full = runner_module.FullCudaGraphBackend.__new__(
+            runner_module.FullCudaGraphBackend
+        )
+        breakable = runner_module.BreakableCudaGraphBackend.__new__(
+            runner_module.BreakableCudaGraphBackend
+        )
+        for backend, captures, expected in (
+            (full, False, True),
+            (breakable, False, False),
+            (breakable, True, True),
+        ):
+            attn_backend = SimpleNamespace(
+                breakable_graph_reads_captured_state=captures
+            )
+            with self.subTest(backend=type(backend).__name__, captures=captures):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    runner_module._replay_waits_for_whole_load(backend, attn_backend),
+                    expected,
+                )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
